description: This file defines the DataGroupPermissionFilterParams class, which encapsulates parameters used for filtering data group permissions in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for user roles, data groups, access controls, and relevant getter/setter methods.

classes.name: DataGroupPermissionFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) for specifying filtering parameters related to data group permissions, including roles, entities, access, and permission settings.

methods.name: getUserRoles
methods.description: Returns the list of UserRole objects associated with the filter parameters.

methods.name: setUserRoles
methods.description: Sets the list of UserRole objects for the filter parameters.

methods.name: isWithApiDataGroups
methods.description: Checks if API data groups should be included.

methods.name: setWithApiDataGroups
methods.description: Sets whether to include API data groups in the filtering process.

methods.name: isOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Checks if only accessible permissions are to be fetched.

methods.name: setOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Sets whether to fetch only permissions that are at least accessible in some form.

methods.name: getRolesToExclude
methods.description: Returns roles that should be excluded from filtering.

methods.name: setRolesToExclude
methods.description: Sets roles to exclude from filtering.

methods.name: getRolesToInclude
methods.description: Returns roles that should be included in filtering.

methods.name: setRolesToInclude
methods.description: Sets roles to include in filtering.

methods.name: getEntities
methods.description: Returns a list of entity identifiers involved in the permission filtering.

methods.name: setEntities
methods.description: Sets the list of entities for permission filtering.

methods.name: getDataGroups
methods.description: Returns data group names involved in filtering.
